{{Quote|The bounty on Louis, as well as his brothers, was placed by a man named Lucien. He leads the Bofa Treat Gang who use this bunker here as their hideout.|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:B" />}}
The '''Bofa Treat Gang bunker''' was the headquarters of the [[Bofa Treat Gang]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located in the [[Vella plains]], near the city of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]].<ref name="SWG:B" />

==History==
{{Quote|You'll find them all inside of that nearby bunker a bit to the south. Go on, I don't have all day to wait.|Bossk, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:B" />}}
[[File:Lucien_Bender.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Lucien Bender]], the leader of the Bofa Treat Gang in the bunker.]]
The Bofa Treat Gang was led by [[Lucien Bender]], a mad scientist whose three sons &mdash; [[Hraykken Bender|Hraykken]], [[Draykken Bender|Draykken]] and [[Louis Bender]] &mdash; escaped their abusive father and founded a rival gang: the [[Meatlumps]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Lucien Bender placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his three sons. However, he ignored that a much larger bounty was placed on him and his gang.<ref name="SWG:B" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] captured Louis Bender and intended to force his brothers Hraykken and Draykken to handle Lucien for him so he could collect the most substantial bounty. However, a spacer affiliated with the Meatlump gang arrived at Bossk's little camp near the Bofa Treat Gang's bunker. Bossk forced the Meatlump to take down the Bofa Treat Gang and their leader for him in exchange of Louis Bender. The spacer entered the building and fought his way through the bunker until he finally met Lucien in the depths of the hideout. The adventurer confronted Lucien Bender and finally killed him.<ref name="SWG:B" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bofa Treat Gang bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:B" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Bofa Treat Gang bunker was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 10|Game Update 10]]," released on [[June 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=927421|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10}}</ref>
